notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {2}{R}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Devastating Onslaught, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Devastating Onslaught, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
